main_text.p: cæ 22.10. Plural. נַרְבִין 1. Sam. 25.18. constr. נִרְבֵי חַמַּר Dolia vini, Joel.1.17.
נַרְבִיתָא, נַרְבֵיתָא Ch. Aquilo, Boreas, Cecias, Prov.25.23. & 27.16. Syr. ܢܪܒܝܬܐ Lucæ 13.29.
נרג Ch.& Syr. Provocare, fuscitare, excitare, Incitare, Exstimulare, Cocitare lites ac discordias, Contendere. Pahel נְרֵג Idem.
נַרְגִּשְׁתָּא, נַרְגְּשְׁתָּא Ch. Gleba, Argilla, Ramentum. Plur. נַרְגִּישְׁתָּא נַרְגִּישִׁין.
נרך Ithpah. אִתְנְרֵךְ Ch. Scabere, scalpere se. Deinde נרך Rabbinis est Texere, Unde נַרְדָּאֵי, נַרְדֵי Ch. Textor, Exod.39.22. in Jonath. Plural. נַרְדָּאִין Textores. Affine est Græc. ναρδοῦς.
גַּרְדָּיָא Ch. Peniculamenta, Num.15.38. in Targ. Jonat. גַּרְדָּא vide in גרר.
נרם Ithpah. אִתְנַרְדֵּם Ch. Fractum est, Psalm.39.12. usitata vox apud Talmudicos quoque.

נרה Pahel נָרֵי Ch. Incitare, concitare, movere, commovere aliquem in alium, provocare. Hinc Syr. ܢܪܝ Et concitarunt cotra eum populum, Act. 21.27. Item Mittere, immittere: Item Jaculari, Ejaculari. Convenit cum גרת. Ithpahel אִתְנָרִי Incitari, Concitari.
תִּגְרָתָא, תִּגְרָא Ch. Contentio, lis, disceptatio, jurgium. Psal.35.1. Plur.constr. תִּגְרֵי Jurgia, Lites, Prov.6.14.19.
תִּגְרָנָא, תִּגְרָן Ch. Contentiosus, Proverb.22.10. Fœmin.

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac forms are transcribed from the scan and may contain small errors; the Syriac vowel-marked words and the Greek word after "Græc." and the Syriac word "Hinc Syr." are approximate. Pointing marks above some Syriac words are only partly legible.
